breadcrumb: All-gender body care / Between showers / External body skin
intro: The day does not always leave room for a second shower. ON THE GO removes surface sweat and residue where odor begins. A textured plant-fiber cloth does the physical work; a mild cleanser and zinc ricinoleate are designed to address the remaining odor impression. It is a practical reset, not an antiperspirant or a substitute for washing.
bullets: Mild surfactants lift residue; zinc ricinoleate is included for odor-binding intent.
Glycerin, panthenol and an acidic pH target support a comfortable finish; fragrance is present.
One individually sealed, two-sided wipe for feet, underarms and body.

mechanism.name: Source Reset System™
mechanism.note: This is the name for a proposed delivery system, not a patented or clinically proven technology. Zinc ricinoleate’s effect in this finished wipe has not been tested.

steps.title: Lift surface residue
steps.body: The embossed side is designed to pick up sweat and surface debris; the smooth side finishes the pass. Physical removal comes first.

steps.title: Clean the skin
steps.body: Mild sugar and amino-acid surfactants help release oily residue. The lotion pH target is 4.5–5.0, pending batch verification.

steps.title: Address odor impression
steps.body: Zinc ricinoleate is included to bind some odor molecules rather than rely on scent alone. A finished-wipe study must establish its effect.

numbers.label: Axillary microbiota study
numbers.note: One study linked bacterial communities with odor differences through the day.

numbers.label: Bacteria in a comparison group
numbers.note: In that study, non-antiperspirant users had more underarm bacteria on average; this is not an ON THE GO result.

numbers.label: Sequences in a small sample
numbers.note: In an 11-person sample, 96% belonged to three common skin-bacteria genera; this is not product efficacy.

sources.label: Axillary microbiota and odor study · PMID 25653852

mechanism.proofTitle: Two paths after a long day.
mechanism.proof: Masking path: sweat and residue remain while fragrance sits over them. Proposed Source Reset path: a wipe removes surface material, cleansing lotion lifts remaining residue, and zinc ricinoleate is intended to bind odor molecules. This is a mechanism diagram, not a measured before-and-after result. A finished-product odor study must establish any difference.

outcomes.body: Skin may feel clean and lightly scented. Sweat production does not stop.
A sealed wipe can be useful at predictable gaps: commute, exercise, and travel. Use only on intact body skin.
The practical gain is a clean-up option where a shower is unavailable. No 24-hour odor control, antibacterial action, or shower-equivalent result is promised.

howToUse: Wipe underarms, feet, or external body skin; use the textured side first and the smooth side to finish. Avoid mucosa, broken skin, and the groin because this proposed version contains fragrance and a cooling agent.
Let skin dry, dress, and bin the wipe. Do not flush. Wash normally when facilities are available.

perspective.body: The American Academy of Dermatology explains that odor forms where sweat mixes with skin bacteria. Its whole-body deodorant guidance cautions against applying fragranced products to the groin. This proposed scented version is therefore focused on underarms, feet, and body skin.
perspective.source: American Academy of Dermatology · Whole-body deodorant
perspective.disclaimer: This independent guidance informs the use decision. It is not an endorsement of Wipelo or this product.

comparison.note: The proposed wipe can physically clean skin but cannot reduce sweat production. Its finished-product odor effect still needs direct testing.

ingredients.intro: Current development formula; check the finished product label before use. The final INCI order must follow the manufactured batch.

tabs.title: Zinc ricinoleate
tabs.body: A zinc salt included to bind some odor molecules in a formulation. It is not an antiperspirant or disinfectant, and it is not proof of finished-wipe efficacy.

tabs.title: Lactic acid + sodium lactate
tabs.body: The intended acidic pH adjustment and buffer. They do not sterilize skin or erase the normal microbiome.

tabs.title: Panthenol + glycerin
tabs.body: Conditioning ingredients for a less tight afterfeel. They do not prevent sweat.

tabs.title: Cloth
tabs.body: Proposed plant-derived lyocell/viscose spunlace, about 20 × 20 cm and 50–60 gsm, with a smooth and textured side. Verify fiber and biodegradation claims before publication.

faqs.question: Is it safe for sensitive or intimate skin?
faqs.answer: This proposed scented version is for intact external body skin such as underarms and feet. Do not use on genital mucosa or the groin. Patch test if fragrance or cooling ingredients bother you. Children should use it only with adult supervision after age-appropriate safety review.

faqs.question: Does it replace washing or deodorant?
faqs.answer: No. A wipe is a bridge until soap and water are available. It does not stop sweat like an antiperspirant; use your usual deodorant if you need longer odor management.

faqs.question: Will it remove every odor?
faqs.answer: No. It removes surface material and contains an odor-binding ingredient, but odor differs by person, fabric, and activity. A persistent new odor deserves medical assessment.

faqs.question: How does the subscription work?
faqs.answer: The product brief proposes 10% savings and a free first-order Welcome Kit. Recurring orders are not available until a Shopify subscription app and selling plan are configured.

faqs.question: What if it does not work for me?
faqs.answer: The proposed First Pack Promise gives you 30 days from delivery to contact support for a refund of the first order. Confirm the final policy terms with the store before purchase.
